content:
Context: 5. Final payment of accumulations in PF

Interest.If the payment cannot be made within one month after retirement or after the date of receipt of application in the prescribed form, whichever is later, due to administrative reasons, interest is payable on the balance up to six months for the period beyond one month. Interest can be allowed up to one year by the Head of Accounts Office and beyond that period by the immediate superior to the Head of Accounts Office.
